text:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream in ap-southeast-1. window=5m, p95=260ms, p99=3.1s. Several streaming sessions report long final-chunk delays. Paging oncall: @mira :rotating_light:

mira: oncall ack. pulling up flamegraphs and request timelines.

oliver: i'm seeing an unusual increase in kernel compile failures in the sidecar logs around the same time. Could be a runtime optimization change.

sana: any recent change? infra or model?

deploy-bot: deploys: inference/runtime@2026-03-20 rolled to ap-southeast-1 at 7135790000 by ci-release; model-serving/weights@v2026-03-18 promoted at 7135788000.

infra-bot: kernel-selection config updated in runtime-config@2026-03-20 at 7135790100 (flags: prefer_fast_attention=true).

mira: quick checks:
```
# promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/stream",region="ap-southeast-1"}[5m])) by (le))
avg_over_time(sidecar_kernel_compile_errors_total{region="ap-southeast-1"}[10m])
```

mira: results: p99 ~3.1s, sidecar compile errors 0 -> 120 (10m window). compile retries correlate with longer tails — retries add ~1.5-2s each.

oliver: compile errors + retries would explain tail. Why did the runtime start preferring a new kernel? That config flip looks suspect.

sana: customer impact: a streaming partner integration reported 5% of sessions with stalls and auto-retries. CS notified.

ops-bridge: suggested mitigations: 1) disable prefer_fast_attention flag, 2) restart sidecar pool to clear transient state, 3) enable streaming fallback chunking for affected region.

ops-bridge: commands:
```
rwi config set runtime.prefer_fast_attention=false --region ap-southeast-1
rwi rollout restart sidecar-pool --region ap-southeast-1 --grace 30s
rwi config set streaming.max_chunk_bytes=64k --region ap-southeast-1
```

mira: disabling flag now. initiating sidecar pool restart.

oliver: while restart proceeds, we should sample a few failed compile logs to see the kernel/arch mismatch. enabling verbose logs at sample 0.5%.

mira: restart done. monitoring signals.

mira: early numbers post-action: p95 255ms -> 220ms, p99 3.1s -> 460ms for restarted pods. compile error counter stopped increasing.

sana: CS update sent: "Mitigation in progress; rolling back a runtime optimization that caused kernel compile retries. Streaming degraded for some sessions; mitigations are showing improvement."

oliver: pulled a failed compile artifact: stacktrace points to vec-permute kernel variant failing on certain GPU microcode with fast_attention enabled. We'll collect affected GPU model strings.

infra-bot: node inventory snapshot for ap-southeast-1: gpu-types: [A10G, H100-L], affected hosts appear to be A10G with driver 525.x. H100 nodes unaffected.

mira: hypothesis: fast_attention kernel chooses a variant incompatible with older driver on A10G, leading to runtime compile fallback/ retry. When compile fails, requests block while sidecar retries, causing streaming tail stalls.

ops-bridge: recommended follow-ups: 1) pin runtime flag off until kernel matrix validated, 2) add driver compatibility gate to rollout pipeline, 3) add metric alert on sidecar compile retries to detect earlier.

oliver: taking ownership for kernel compatibility RCA. I'll collect driver/kernel-matrix, failing kernel names, and rollout history.

sana: I'll coordinate CS and customer follow-ups — listing impacted accounts and support tickets.

mira: paging SRE rotation: creating incident INC-713579 for tracking. I'll stay for monitoring and post-incident notes.

incident-bot: Incident INC-713579 created (runtime-kernel-compile-spike-aps1). Paging SRE rotation.

mira: handoff to oliver at 7135790400 — oliver is live owner for RCA. I'll keep monitoring for 30 minutes and will update the incident doc.

oliver: ack. immediate next steps: gather kernel/driver matrix, reproduce on a test A10G node, and bake compatibility test into CI.

infra-bot: snapshotting logs and attaching node-metadata to INC-713579.

mira: post-mitigation note: p99 back to ~500ms across region; continuing to observe. Reopen if tail reappears.

sana: CS final update: "Issue mitigated; runtime optimization rolled back. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with RCA and timeline."

oliver: will produce RCA and remediation plan (compatibility gate + preflight test) and post to INC-713579.

mira: thanks team. good triage and quick rollback. :thumbsup:
